spans.s: भङ्कारी भङ्कारी, f. a gad-fly.
भङ्क्ति भङ्क्ति, भङ्ग. See p. 697, col. 1.
भङ्क्ति, इस्, f. breaking, fracture.

भङ्गान भङ्गान, अस्, m. a kind of carp,
Cyprinus Banganna.

भङ्गारी भङ्गारी, f. a gad-fly; (perhaps
an incorrect form for भङ्कारी above.)

भङ्क्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who breaks, breaking,
a breaker.

भङ्क्त्वा, ind. having broken, having broken
into.

भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking, splitting, shattering,
breaking down, breaking up; a break, breach; frac-
ture [cf. अस्थि-भ्˚]; chasm, fissure, division; break-
ing up, the being broken up; breaking to pieces,
separation, analysis, taking to pieces; a piece broken
off, detached portion, fragment [cf. मृणाल-भ्˚];
falling to pieces, fall, downfall, ruin, destruction;
decay (e. g. क्षण-भ्˚, momentary decay; with
Buddhists, the constant decay taking place in the
universe, constant flux or change); defeat, overthrow
(opposed to जय), discomfiture; interruption, stop-
page, impediment, suspension, non-performance [cf.
दण्ड-भ्˚]; frustration, disappointment; rejection,
refusal [cf. प्रणय-भ्˚]; humiliation; derogation,
abatement; taking to flight, flight; going, motion;
panic, fear; bowing, bending, stretching (e. g. गात्र-
भ्˚, the bending or stretching of the limbs); knit-
ting (the brow); a bend, fold (of a garment); a
wave; paralysis, palsy, disease; fraud, deceit, false-
hood; a water-course, canal; hemp; N. of a Nāga;
= भङ्गि, a tortuous course, roundabout mode of
acting or speaking; (Ved.) an epithet of Soma,
[]
(according to Sāy. भज्यते ग्रावभिः, or शत्रू-
णाम् भञ्जकः); (आ), f. hemp (Cannabis Sativa);
the plant Convolvulus Turpethum; an intoxicating
beverage prepared from the hemp plant; [cf. Gr.
ἀγή; Lith. bangà, ‘a wave, flood.’]
—भङ्ग-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing a breach, making a fissure;
(अस्), m., N. of a son of A-vikṣit; of a son of
Sattra-jit.
—भङ्ग-कार, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भङ्ग-नय, अस्, m. removal of obstacles,
removing a difficulty in argument or reasoning.
—भङ्ग-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, experiencing a fracture,
being broken.
—भङ्ग-वासा, f. turmeric.
—भङ्-
ग-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a man; [cf. भङ्ग्य-
श्रवस्.]
—भङ्ग-सार्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, deceitful,
fraudulent, dishonest.
—भङ्गा-कट, अम्, n. the
pollen of hemp.
—भङ्गासुर (˚ग-अस्˚), अस्, m.,
see भाङ्गासुरि.
—भङ्गा-स्वन, अस्, m., N. of
a Rājarṣi.

भाङ्ग भाङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भङ्गा, hemp),
hempen, of hemp, made or consisting of hemp.

भङ्गि, इस्, or भङ्गी, f. breaking, fracture,
breach, division; bending; incurvation; undulation;
a wave; a crooked path, tortuous course; current;
a roundabout mode of acting or speaking, circum-
locution; irony, wit, repartee; mere appearance or
semblance, pretext, disguise, trick, fraud, deception;
modesty; a step; an interval.
—भङ्गि-मत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, possessing waves or undulations, wavy,
crisp, curled.
—भङ्गी-भक्ति, इस्, f. division or
separation into (a series of) waves or wave-like
steps.

भङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fragile, transient, transitory,
perishable; (in law) defeated or cast in a suit.
—भङ्गि-भाव, अस्, m. the state of being bent,
frowning aspect.
भङ्गील, अम्, n. defect in the organs of sense.
भाङ्गिल भाङ्गिल, N. of a place.

भङ्गुर, अस्, आ, अम्, apt to break, fragile, brittle;
frail, transient, transitory, evanescent, of short dura-
tion, perishable; changeable, changeful, variable;
crooked, bent, wrinkled; curved, curled, crisped;
fraudulent, crafty, dishonest; (अस्), m. a bend or
reach of a river, the elbow of a river; (आ), f., N. of
two plants (= अति-विषा, प्रियङ्गु).
—भङ्गुर-
ता, f. fragility, transitoriness.
—भङ्गुर-निश्चय,
अस्, आ, अम्, forming changeable resolutions, vacillating.
—भङ्गुरा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. (perhaps) in-
triguing, crafty, treacherous.

भङ्गुरय, Nom. P. भङ्गुरयति, -यितुम्,
to break to pieces, destroy; to crisp, curl (trans.).

भङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken, fit to be
broken, breakable: (अम्), n., scil. क्षेत्र, a field
of hemp.
—भङ्ग्य-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a man;
[cf. भङ्ग-श्रवस्.]

भाङ्कार भाङ्-कार, perhaps = झङ्-कार,
q. v.; [cf. भेरी-भ्˚.]

भाङ्गक (fr. भङ्ग, a fracture), a tattered or
ragged cloth.

भाङ्गासुरि, इस्, m. (fr. भङ्गासुर), a patro-
nymic of Ṛtu-parṇa.
—भाङ्गासुरि-नृपाज्ञा (˚प-
आज्˚), f. the command of king Bhāṅgāsuri.

भाङ्गीन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भङ्गा), bearing or
growing hemp; (अम्), n., scil. क्षेत्र, a field of
hemp.

भाङ्गिलेय, अस्, m., N. of a man; (अस्, ई, अम्),
coming from Bhāṅgila (?).
